answer: I did not submit a job. Garnet cannot run a 30-qubit GHZ circuit because it has only 20 qubits. The free arch query confirmed this: it lists 20 qubits, QB1 to QB20, and no resonators. The docs agree and describe garnet as Crystal 20 with 20 qubits. The server would reject any 30-qubit circuit sent to garnet, so I spent no credits. You can run a GHZ circuit of up to 20 qubits on garnet instead. You can also run 30 qubits on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs 0.75 credits per second. Tell me which option you want.
